disciplines.name: Animalism
disciplines.summary: Bend animals to the vampire's will by asserting the Beast's dominance.

powers.name: Feral Whispers
powers.duration: Scene; a command can last up to one night
powers.summary: Talk with animals, question them, and give simple orders.

powers.name: Raise the Familiar

cost.note: The 1 Vitae is fed to the animal corpse

powers.summary: Revive a dead animal as a Vitae-sustained servant linked to the vampire.

powers.name: Summon the Hunt

cost.note: Includes 1 Vitae spilled on the target

powers.duration: One night, or until the blood-marked item is destroyed
powers.summary: Spilled Vitae draws nearby predators and scavengers, who obey one command.

powers.name: Feral Infection

cost.note: Includes 1 Vitae spilled on the ground

dicePool.resistance: Resolve + Composure − vampire's successes (reflexive roll by humans and supernatural victims)

powers.summary: Send animals and people nearby into a directed, frenzied rage.

powers.name: Lord of the Land

cost.note: 3 Vitae for a house, 6 for a city block, 9 for a castle

powers.duration: One week per dot of Blood Potency; longer while the vampire stays inside
powers.summary: Claim a Vitae-marked territory that repels intruders and reveals all within it.

disciplines.name: Auspex
disciplines.summary: Heightened predatory senses that uncover secrets, weaknesses and hidden things.

powers.name: Beast's Hackles

cost.note: First use in a scene free; later uses that scene 1 Vitae each

powers.summary: Sense immediate danger or weakness; ask the Storyteller a question.

powers.name: Uncanny Perception

cost.note: First use per scene free; later uses on the same target that scene 1 Vitae each

powers.summary: Ask one question per success about a single person's secrets.

powers.name: The Spirit's Touch
powers.summary: Read the history and emotions tied to an object or place.

powers.name: Lay Open the Mind

cost.note: Each extra memory uncovered costs 1 more Vitae

powers.summary: Hear a target's thoughts, send thoughts, and pull up memories.

powers.name: Twilight Projection
powers.summary: Leave the body as an intangible, fast-moving astral form.

disciplines.name: Celerity
disciplines.summary: Supernatural speed that improves defense and allows bursts of action.

powers.name: Celerity

cost.note: Persistent effects are free; each active effect costs 1 Vitae

powers.summary: Persistent Defense bonus; spend Vitae for initiative, interrupts or extreme speed.

disciplines.name: Dominate
disciplines.summary: Command and reshape minds through eye contact and the Beast's authority.

powers.name: Mesmerize
powers.summary: Catch a victim's gaze, then give short direct commands or plant a memory.

powers.name: Iron Edict

cost.note: Free if the victim is in Vinculum with the vampire

powers.duration: Until the task is done or sunrise
powers.summary: Give a Mesmerized victim a command of up to three sentences.

powers.name: Entombed Command

cost.note: No cost itself; Dominate powers attached to triggers cost Vitae as normal

powers.duration: One week per success, or one month per success if in Vinculum
powers.summary: Plant subconscious triggers that fire other Dominate effects later.

powers.name: The Lying Mind

cost.note: Includes 1 Vitae fed to or dripped on the victim

powers.summary: Create, erase or rewrite a victim's memories permanently.

powers.name: Possession
powers.summary: Move the vampire's mind into a victim and control his body.

disciplines.name: Majesty
disciplines.summary: Supernatural charisma that draws attention, affection and devotion.

powers.name: Awe
powers.summary: Become the centre of attention, ignoring social penalties and boosting Presence.

powers.name: Confidant

cost.note: Requires having used Awe on the victim

powers.summary: Charm one person already under Awe.

powers.name: Green Eyes

cost.note: Each emotional shift costs 1 Vitae, can hit many victims at once

powers.summary: Manipulate the emotions and obsessions of charmed followers.

powers.name: Loyalty
powers.summary: Turn a charmed victim into a fanatically loyal, Enthralled follower.

powers.name: Idol
powers.summary: Amplify Awe so onlookers struggle to act against the vampire.

disciplines.name: Nightmare
disciplines.summary: Project the Beast's horror to frighten, delude and traumatize victims.

powers.name: Dread Presence
powers.summary: Unsettling aura boosts Intimidation, blocks offensive Willpower, allows tiny illusions.

powers.name: Face of the Beast
powers.summary: Magnify a victim's fear so he flees, Frightened.

powers.name: The Grand Delusion
powers.summary: Implant a false belief, inflicting the Delusional Condition.

powers.name: Waking Nightmare

dicePool.resistance: highest Composure + Blood Potency in group

powers.summary: Create a single all-senses nightmarish hallucination.

powers.name: Mortal Terror
powers.summary: Terror deals lethal damage per success and leaves the victim Broken.

disciplines.name: Obfuscate
disciplines.summary: Hide the vampire, objects or places from others' minds and perceptions.

powers.name: Face in the Crowd
powers.summary: Go unnoticed and unremembered while not drawing attention.

powers.name: Touch of Shadow

cost.note: Must touch the subject; Size up to the vampire's own

powers.summary: Make a touched object or animal go unnoticed.

powers.name: Cloak of Night
powers.summary: Vanish entirely from perception; Touch of Shadow can now hide people.

powers.name: The Familiar Stranger
powers.summary: Appear as a chosen type of person or specific individual; disguise objects.

powers.name: Oubliette

cost.note: 3 Vitae for an apartment, 6 for a brownstone, 9 for a mansion; must also sleep a day there

powers.duration: 1 week per dot of Blood Potency
powers.summary: Turn a Vitae-marked haven into a controllable illusory domain.

disciplines.name: Protean
disciplines.summary: Reshape the vampire's body, from sinking into earth to becoming mist.

powers.name: Unmarked Grave

cost.note: Free for soil or earth; otherwise Vitae equal to the material's Durability

powers.summary: Merge into the ground and rest there, nearly immune to harm.

powers.name: Predatory Aspect
powers.summary: Manifest chosen bestial adaptations such as claws or wall crawling.

powers.name: Beast's Skin
powers.summary: Transform into a predatory animal the vampire has killed by feeding.

powers.name: Unnatural Aspect

cost.note: Paid on top of Predatory Aspect

powers.summary: Add a monstrous fourth adaptation such as wings or horrid talons.

powers.name: Primeval Miasma
powers.summary: Become a cloud of smoke immune to most harm.

disciplines.name: Resilience
disciplines.summary: Unnatural toughness that raises Stamina and shrugs off severe damage.

powers.name: Resilience

cost.note: Persistent effects are free; each active effect costs 1 Vitae

powers.summary: Persistent Stamina bonus and aggravated downgrade; spend Vitae to reduce damage.

disciplines.name: Vigor
disciplines.summary: Supernatural strength for crushing blows, huge jumps and hurling heavy objects.

powers.name: Vigor

cost.note: Persistent effects are free; each active effect costs 1 Vitae

powers.summary: Persistent Strength bonus and jumping; spend Vitae for heavy strikes or hurling objects.

disciplines.name: Crúac
disciplines.summary: Circle of the Crone blood magic fuelled by the Beast and spilled Vitae.

castingCost.note: 1 Vitae per dot of the rite

disciplines.name: Theban Sorcery
disciplines.summary: Lancea et Sanctum miracles invoking God's Curse through faith and sacrament.

merits.name: Acute Senses
merits.summary: Senses twice as sharp as a mortal's; sees in total darkness.

merits.name: Altar
merits.summary: Shared ritual altar letting a group use teamwork on Crúac rituals.

merits.name: Anointed
merits.summary: Preach once per chapter to give a crowd the Raptured Condition.

merits.name: Atrocious

prerequisites.text: Cannot also have the Cutthroat or Enticing Merit

merits.summary: Monstrous Beast: 8-again to invoke it, no 10-again with the other Beasts.

merits.name: Attaché
merits.summary: Each Retainer also brings Contacts, Resources or Safe Place dots.

merits.name: Bloodhound
merits.summary: Reads and tracks blood by scent alone, without tasting it.

merits.name: Cacophony Savvy

styleManeuvers.name: Gettin' Up
styleManeuvers.summary: Intelligence + Streetwise to decode Cacophony signs; extra details cost -1 die each.

styleManeuvers.name: Backpacker
styleManeuvers.summary: Learns newcomers' feeding grounds and aliases within a week.

styleManeuvers.name: Wearing a Hat
styleManeuvers.summary: Once per chapter, Wits + Politics; ask one city-gossip question per success.

merits.summary: Reads and spreads the hidden Kindred message network; each dot adds a power.

merits.name: Carthian Pull
merits.summary: Monthly borrowed Allies, Contacts, Haven and Herd dots from the Movement.

merits.name: Claws of the Unholy
merits.summary: Frenzied Unnatural Aspect claws deal aggravated damage, bypassing most armor.

merits.name: Close Family
merits.summary: Stronger blood sympathy: +1 bonus, 8-again, relations count one step closer.

merits.name: Cutthroat

prerequisites.text: Cannot also have the Atrocious or Enticing Merit

merits.summary: Competitive Beast: 8-again to invoke it, no 10-again with the other Beasts.

merits.name: Distinguished Palate
merits.summary: Taste of Blood rolls are exceptional on one success; has a preferred vessel type.

merits.name: Dream Visions
merits.summary: Nightly Blood Potency roll for a yes/no insight about someone or somewhere new.

merits.name: Dynasty Membership

styleManeuvers.name: New Kid
styleManeuvers.summary: Once per chapter, use the eldest member's Clan Status on a Social pool.

styleManeuvers.name: Exemplar
styleManeuvers.summary: Skip the first Door against those who respect or fear the dynasty.

styleManeuvers.name: Patriarch/Matriarch
styleManeuvers.summary: Once per chapter, give a member the Tasked Condition.

merits.summary: Belongs to a known Kindred dynasty; higher dots grant more pull.

merits.name: Enticing

prerequisites.text: Cannot also have the Atrocious or Cutthroat Merit

merits.summary: Seductive Beast: 8-again to invoke it, no 10-again with the other Beasts.

merits.name: Feeding Grounds
merits.summary: Productive hunting territory boosting hunting and predatory aura rolls.

merits.name: Friends in High Places
merits.summary: Each month, open Doors equal to Status with people acting for an organization.

merits.name: Haven
merits.summary: A secure, familiar daytime resting place tied to a Safe Place.

merits.name: Herd
merits.summary: Willing mortals supplying blood each week without a hunting roll.

merits.name: Honey Trap
merits.summary: Vampires who drink your Vitae regain Willpower; new or deeper bonds give a Beat.

merits.name: Invested
merits.summary: Gain Herd, Mentor, Resources or Retainer dots equal to Invictus Status.

merits.name: City Status
merits.summary: Standing in the city's Kindred society; works like Status within the city.

merits.name: Clan Status

prerequisites.text: Only for the character's own clan

merits.summary: Recognition within your own clan; works like Status within the clan.

merits.name: Covenant Status
merits.summary: Rank within a covenant; works like Status there and unlocks covenant Merits.

merits.name: Kiss of the Succubus
merits.summary: Bite leaves mortals Addicted as well as Swooning.

merits.name: Lineage
merits.summary: Once per chapter, the sire's name stands in for one dot of a social Merit.

merits.name: Lorekeeper
merits.summary: Buying Library also yields Retainer and Herd dots.

merits.name: The Mother-Daughter Bond
merits.summary: Your Mentor gains True Friend protection for free.

merits.name: Night Doctor Surgery
merits.summary: Hour-long Intelligence + Medicine treatment downgrades a vampire's wounds.

merits.name: Speaker for the Silent
merits.summary: Lets a torpid elder take over and speak through your body.

merits.name: Pack Alpha
merits.summary: Designated pack members get 8-again when assisting in teamwork.

merits.name: Unnatural Affinity
merits.summary: Each dot lets you feed on one type of supernatural creature.

merits.name: Swarm Form
merits.summary: Beast's Skin can become a swarm of tiny animals.

merits.name: Secret Society Junkie
merits.summary: Status or Mystery Cult Initiation in outside groups also grants Herd dots.

merits.name: Sworn
merits.summary: Sworn to an Ordo Dracul branch; gain Mentor and Retainer dots equal to Status.

merits.name: I Know a Guy
merits.summary: Once per story, temporary Retainer dots equal to your Allies.

merits.name: Touchstone
merits.summary: Extra Touchstones anchored to lower Humanity dots.

merits.name: Undead Menses
merits.summary: Once nightly blood that aids Crúac and weakens resistance to Disciplines.

merits.name: Unsettling Gaze
merits.summary: Exceptional Bestial infliction can force a breaking point on the victim.

merits.name: Where the Bodies Are Buried
merits.summary: Ask secret questions about known vampires, uses equal to Status per story.

merits.name: Lex Terrae
merits.summary: Blood poached from your feeding ground sickens and marks the poacher.

merits.name: Mandate from the Masses
merits.summary: A Movement vote strips Blood Potency from an enemy.

merits.name: Right of Return
merits.summary: Carthian Status doesn't count against holding other Covenant Status.

merits.name: Strength of Resolution
merits.summary: Add Carthian Status to resist powers pushing you to break city law.

merits.name: Plausible Deniability
merits.summary: Supernatural attempts to prove your guilt in breaking city law fail.

merits.name: Notary
merits.summary: Officiates Invictus Oaths; immune to others' Invictus Status in rolls.

merits.name: Oath of Action
merits.summary: Vassal borrows a liege's Discipline to perform a set task.

merits.name: Oath of Fealty
merits.summary: Vassal may draw weekly Vitae from the liege at any distance.

merits.name: Oath of Penance
merits.summary: Liege receives every tenth Vitae the vassal drinks; vassal immune to liege's Disciplines.

merits.name: Oath of Serfdom
merits.summary: Landlord-tenant Oath granting a physical Discipline dot within the granted land.

merits.name: Kindred Dueling

styleManeuvers.name: Hamstring
styleManeuvers.summary: A targeted limb strike denies that limb Physical Intensity for a turn.

styleManeuvers.name: Taunt
styleManeuvers.summary: Drop dice up to Weaponry; a hit forces a frenzy check penalized by that amount.

styleManeuvers.name: Carving
styleManeuvers.summary: Weapon damage counts as lethal against Kindred.

styleManeuvers.name: Pincushion
styleManeuvers.summary: Leave the blade in; the wound can't be healed with Vitae until removed.

styleManeuvers.name: Spray
styleManeuvers.summary: Give up Defense for the turn; damage can drain Vitae instead of Health.

merits.summary: Bladed fighting style exploiting vampire weaknesses.

merits.name: Riding the Wave

styleManeuvers.name: Ravage
styleManeuvers.summary: Bite attacks become a 1L weapon.

styleManeuvers.name: Primal Strength
styleManeuvers.summary: Frenzy Strength bonus doubles for lifting, jumping and breaking.

styleManeuvers.name: In the Zone
styleManeuvers.summary: Willpower spent to ride the wave also adds +3 dice to that turn's action.

styleManeuvers.name: Unyielding
styleManeuvers.summary: Get back Willpower spent to ride the wave after a successful scene.

styleManeuvers.name: Animal Grace
styleManeuvers.summary: Willpower on attack or defense gives both: +2 Defense and +3 to attack.

merits.summary: Style usable only while riding the wave with the Beast.

merits.name: Allies
merits.summary: An organization or group that does favors for you.

merits.name: Alternate Identity
merits.summary: A false identity that holds up to more scrutiny at higher dots.

merits.name: Anonymity
merits.summary: Lives off the grid; paper-trail searches are penalized.

merits.name: Area of Expertise
merits.summary: One chosen Specialty gives +2 dice instead of +1.

merits.name: Barfly
merits.summary: Fits in at any social gathering without needing a roll.

merits.name: Contacts
merits.summary: One sphere of information sources per dot.

merits.name: Double Jointed
merits.summary: Slips mundane bonds automatically and resists being overpowered in grapples.

merits.name: Etiquette

styleManeuvers.name: Bless His Heart
styleManeuvers.summary: Use Socialize rather than lower of Resolve/Composure for starting Doors.

styleManeuvers.name: Losing Your Religion
styleManeuvers.summary: Insults get 8-again and +2 dice, but worsen the impression a step.

styleManeuvers.name: In High Cotton
styleManeuvers.summary: Add one relevant Status or Fame Merit to contest Social rolls.

styleManeuvers.name: Half-Cocked
styleManeuvers.summary: With a good or better impression, first roll ignores target's Resolve and Composure.

styleManeuvers.name: Grace Under Fire
styleManeuvers.summary: When forced to concede, pick from three Conditions the other side offers.

merits.summary: Social style for poise, insults and reputation in Social Maneuvering.

merits.name: Fame
merits.summary: Known for something; bonus with admirers but easier to find.

merits.name: Fast-Talking

styleManeuvers.name: Always Be Closing
styleManeuvers.summary: Mark's Resolve or Composure is reduced by 1 when resisting you.

styleManeuvers.name: Jargon
styleManeuvers.summary: Apply one relevant Specialty to any Social roll.

styleManeuvers.name: Devil's Advocacy
styleManeuvers.summary: Reroll one failed Subterfuge roll per scene.

styleManeuvers.name: Salting
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower after opening a Door to open a second.

styleManeuvers.name: Patron's Privilege
styleManeuvers.summary: When the mark regains Willpower from Vice/Dirge, roll to open a Door at once.

merits.summary: Style of rapid, confusing persuasion.

merits.name: Fleet of Foot
merits.summary: Runs much faster than expected and is hard to chase down.

merits.name: Hobbyist Clique

prerequisites.text: Member of a clique whose members all have this Merit and the chosen Skill at 2+

merits.summary: Membership in a hobby group built around one Skill.

merits.name: Indomitable
merits.summary: Strong resistance to supernatural mind and emotion control.

merits.name: Inspiring
merits.summary: Rousing speech gives listeners the Inspired Condition.

merits.name: Interdisciplinary Specialty

prerequisites.text: A Skill at 3 or more with a Specialty in it

merits.summary: One Specialty's bonus applies to other Skills when it fits.

merits.name: Iron Will
merits.summary: Willpower spent resisting socially can use Resolve instead.

merits.name: Language
merits.summary: Speaks, reads and writes an additional language.

merits.name: Library
merits.summary: Research resources for one Mental Skill.

merits.name: Mentor
merits.summary: A teacher who grants favors in three Skills, for a price.

merits.name: Mystery Cult Initiation
merits.summary: Rank in a mystery cult with benefits at each level.

merits.name: Parkour

styleManeuvers.name: Flow
styleManeuvers.summary: Lowers foot-chase successes needed and ignores some Athletics penalties.

styleManeuvers.name: Cat Leap
styleManeuvers.summary: Better fall-damage reduction, even for lethal falls.

styleManeuvers.name: Wall Run
styleManeuvers.summary: Climb 10 feet plus 5 per Athletics dot as an instant action, no roll.

styleManeuvers.name: Expert Traceur
styleManeuvers.summary: Spend Willpower to make one run/jump/climb roll a rote action.

styleManeuvers.name: Freeflow
styleManeuvers.summary: After a minute of running, Athletics actions reflexively; Willpower gives 3 successes.

merits.summary: Free-running style for chases, falls and climbing.

merits.name: Resources
merits.summary: Disposable income for acquiring items.

merits.name: Retainer
merits.summary: A loyal assistant or follower.

merits.name: Safe Place
merits.summary: A secure location, optionally trapped; dots can be pooled by a group.

merits.name: Sleight of Hand
merits.summary: One Larceny instant action per turn becomes reflexive and unnoticed.

merits.name: Staff
merits.summary: Workers who automatically get one success on routine tasks.

merits.name: Status
merits.summary: Standing within a particular group or organization.

merits.name: Striking Looks
merits.summary: Eye-catching appearance boosts Social rolls but draws attention.

merits.name: Sympathetic
merits.summary: Accept a Condition to remove two Doors at the start of maneuvering.

merits.name: Taste

prerequisites.text: A Specialty in Crafts or Expression

merits.summary: Expert appraiser of art and craft details.

merits.name: Trained Observer
merits.summary: Perception rolls gain 9-again, or 8-again at three dots.

merits.name: True Friend
merits.summary: A friend who won't betray you and restores Willpower.

merits.name: Unseen Sense
merits.summary: Senses the nearby presence of one supernatural creature type.

banes.name: Bells
banes.summary: Hearing real bells (or hymns, for some) deals (10 - Humanity) bashing dice per minute and provokes frenzy.

banes.name: Blood of the Unwilling
banes.summary: When feeding on an unwilling vessel, the first (10 - Humanity) Vitae taken give no nourishment.

banes.name: Crossroads
banes.summary: After knowingly crossing a crossroads, all dice pools are capped at Humanity for the scene.

banes.name: Face of Hunger
banes.summary: Below 5 Vitae, looks corpse-like: Humanity caps Social actions and pools to resist hunger frenzy.

banes.name: Grave Soil
banes.summary: Sleeping without soil from the region of death caps all dice pools at Humanity the next night.

banes.name: Hated by Beasts
banes.summary: Animals are hostile; Animal Ken and Animalism attempts take a (10 - Humanity) penalty.

banes.name: Holy Day
banes.summary: On one chosen weekday, cannot resist daysleep or wake unless the body takes damage equal to 10 - Humanity.

banes.name: Invitation
banes.summary: Entering a private home uninvited deals (10 - Humanity) bashing damage, unhealable while still inside.

banes.name: Open Wounds
banes.summary: Vitae can heal Health, but wounds stay visibly open until the vampire has slept through the day.

banes.name: Plague of Purity
banes.summary: Touch from a human with Integrity 8+ deals (10 - Humanity) bashing damage.

banes.name: Rat King/Queen
banes.summary: Constantly accompanied by vermin; non-Intimidation Social rolls fail. A Willpower point dismisses them for Humanity minutes.

banes.name: Repulsion
banes.summary: Pick a common substance; approaching within (10 - Humanity) feet costs Willpower, and it deals (10 - Humanity) bashing dice in a wound.

banes.name: Symbols
banes.summary: Touched by, or acting against someone holding, a faith symbol: dice pools capped at Humanity.

banes.name: Webs
banes.summary: Touching a spider web traps the vampire; the web has Durability (10 - Humanity) to break.

clans.name: Daeva

bane.name: The Wanton Curse
bane.summary: From the second feeding on one mortal onward, roll Humanity; on failure gain Persistent Dependent toward them until they die.

clans.summary: Seductive predators who exploit mortal desire and beauty to feed and manipulate.

clans.name: Gangrel

bane.name: The Feral Curse
bane.summary: Dice pools to resist frenzy cannot exceed Humanity dots; riding the wave is unaffected.

clans.summary: Primal, hard-to-kill survivors who embrace their Beast and take animal forms.

clans.name: Mekhet

bane.name: The Tenebrous Curse
bane.summary: Gains one extra bane (no breaking point, counts toward the limit of three); Humanity counts one lower for Humanity-based banes, sunlight and torpor.

clans.summary: Secretive spies and seers who hunt hidden knowledge and move unseen.

clans.name: Nosferatu

bane.name: The Lonely Curse
bane.summary: With humans, Humanity counts two lower for Social penalties and Presence or Manipulation failures become dramatic; not with Touchstones or Kindred.

clans.summary: Unsettling, often deformed lurkers who wield fear and dwell apart from society.

clans.name: Ventrue

bane.name: The Aloof Curse
bane.summary: First Touchstone sits on Humanity 7, so the first Humanity loss detaches it; others go on dots 6 down to 2.

clans.summary: Domineering aristocrats who seek control over people, wealth and institutions.

covenants.name: Carthian Movement
covenants.summary: Revolutionaries who adapt modern human political systems to overturn elder rule and reshape Kindred government.

covenants.name: Circle of the Crone
covenants.summary: A loose pagan alliance of blood-cults that embraces monstrosity as natural and rejects imposed dogma.

covenants.name: Invictus
covenants.summary: The entrenched aristocracy of the Kindred, guarding the Masquerade and holding power through hierarchy and wealth.

covenants.name: Lancea et Sanctum
covenants.summary: The Kindred church, believing vampires are damned to test humanity's faith as God's instruments.

covenants.name: Ordo Dracul
covenants.summary: Occult seekers following Dracula's example, studying the supernatural to transcend the vampiric curse.

rituals.name: Pangs of Proserpina
rituals.summary: Inflicts ravenous hunger on a target up to a mile away, risking frenzy.

rituals.name: Rigor Mortis
rituals.summary: Stiffens a nearby vampire; their next physical action takes a -3 penalty.

rituals.name: Cheval
rituals.summary: Touched subject becomes the caster's eyes and ears for the night.

rituals.name: The Hydra’s Vitae
rituals.summary: Caster's blood turns poisonous to anyone drinking it until sunrise.

rituals.name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
rituals.summary: Staking attempts against the caster fail until sunrise.

rituals.name: Touch of the Morrigan
rituals.summary: Charged palm strike deals lethal damage equal to Potency, once.

rituals.name: Blood Price
rituals.summary: Caster siphons Vitae the present subject drinks, up to Potency, until sunrise.

rituals.name: Willful Vitae
rituals.summary: Caster is immune to new blood bonds and addiction tonight.

rituals.name: Blood Blight
rituals.summary: Destroys target's blood: lethal damage to mortals, Vitae loss to undead.

rituals.name: Feeding the Crone
rituals.summary: Fangs become a vicious maw: +2 aggravated bite, but no Vitae gained.

rituals.name: Blood Scourge
rituals.sacrament: The ritualist's own blood (at least one Vitae)
rituals.summary: Caster can form a 2L whip from his Vitae before sunrise.

rituals.name: Vitae Reliquary
rituals.summary: Stores up to Potency Vitae in an object for a lunar month.

rituals.name: Blandishment of Sin
rituals.summary: Next bashing damage the named victim takes becomes lethal.

rituals.name: Blandishment of Sin (Advanced)
rituals.summary: Next lethal damage the named victim takes becomes aggravated.

rituals.name: Curse of Babel
rituals.summary: Target within a mile cannot speak or write until sunrise.

rituals.name: Liar’s Plague
rituals.summary: Present victim who lies during the next scene coughs up beetles.

rituals.name: Malediction of Despair
rituals.sacrament: A lock of the victim's hair
rituals.summary: Victim's next attempt at a chosen action suffers -5 dice, once.

rituals.name: Stigmata
rituals.summary: Victim bleeds for Potency turns: lethal damage or Vitae loss each turn.

rituals.name: Gift of Lazarus
rituals.sacrament: A communion wafer under the corpse's tongue
rituals.summary: Animates a corpse as a Willpower-less servant for up to a month.

rituals.name: Transubstantiation
rituals.summary: Changes a present thing no bigger than the caster into another substance until sunrise.

devotions.name: Body of Will
devotions.summary: Ignore wound penalties briefly; taking damage fuels one free Vigor effect.

devotions.name: Chain of Command
devotions.summary: Plant a stored Dominate command in someone, to be used on a chosen target later.

devotions.name: Cloak the Gathering

cost.note: Paid on top of Touch of Shadow; Cloak of Night extra cost also applies

devotions.summary: Extend Touch of Shadow and Cloak of Night to hide a group alongside you.

devotions.name: Conditioning
devotions.requirement: Target must already be Mesmerized by the vampire; usable on the same target once every two nights.
devotions.summary: Gradually wear down a Mesmerized victim into Subservience, then Enslavement.

devotions.name: Cross-Contamination

dicePool.text: Presence + Empathy + Lower of Majesty or Nightmare

devotions.summary: Mixed aura of awe and dread disorients onlookers and draws every eye.

devotions.name: Cult of Personality
devotions.summary: Apply Loyalty to a whole crowd, Enthralling everyone weaker-willed.

devotions.name: Enchantment
devotions.summary: Loyalty that binds the victim's devotion to another person, place or object.

devotions.name: Enfeebling Aura
devotions.summary: Trade your own Majesty dots to strip a foe's physical Disciplines for the scene.

devotions.name: Foul Grave
devotions.summary: Sense nearby beings and use predatory aura while buried in Unmarked Grave.

devotions.name: Force of Nature
devotions.summary: Freely mix Protean aspect benefits and reshuffle Physical Attributes for a scene.

devotions.name: Gargoyle’s Vigilance

cost.note: Use while asleep costs 1 Willpower

devotions.summary: Stay still in your haven to watch all of it and pounce on intruders.

devotions.name: Gargoyle’s Vigilance (Advanced)

cost.note: Use while asleep costs 1 Willpower

devotions.summary: As Gargoyle’s Vigilance, but the still vampire becomes a statue immune to fire and sunlight.

devotions.name: Hint of Fear

cost.note: Plus Face of the Beast's own cost

dicePool.text: None, roll normally for Face of the Beast

devotions.summary: Use Face of the Beast reflexively with a fleeting, unnoticed glance.

devotions.name: Juggernaut’s Gait

cost.note: Per turn

devotions.summary: Become totally immune to damage for each turn you pay for.

devotions.name: Quicken Sight
devotions.summary: For one turn perceive in slow motion; Defense applies against ranged attacks.

devotions.name: Reason’s Salon
devotions.summary: Anoint a venue so vampires there struggle with predatory aura and resist frenzy.

devotions.name: Riot
devotions.summary: Drive a whole neighbourhood into violent chaos; a severe Humanity breaking point.

devotions.name: Shared Sight
devotions.summary: Lend some of your Auspex dots to another for the scene.

devotions.name: Shatter the Shroud
devotions.summary: After beating a concealment power, end it outright for the target.

devotions.name: Stalwart Servant
devotions.summary: A servant who drinks your blood borrows your Resilience for a night.

devotions.name: Subsume the Lesser Beast
devotions.requirement: Feed the animal 1 Vitae (included in the cost).
devotions.summary: Possess a predator or vermin animal while your own body lies dormant.

devotions.name: Summoning

dicePool.text: Manipulation + Persuasion + (Dominate or Majesty) vs. Composure + Blood Potency

devotions.requirement: Dominate version: target Mesmerized by the vampire within the past year. Majesty version: target affected by Awe within the past year.
devotions.summary: Compel someone you know, anywhere, to journey to you. Learned via one Discipline.

devotions.name: Sun’s Brutal Dreamscape
devotions.summary: A touched sleeping vampire also suffers any sunlight burns you take.

devotions.name: Touch of Deprivation
devotions.summary: A touch shuts off one of the victim's senses for the scene.

devotions.name: Undying Familiar
devotions.summary: A ghouled animal rises as a long-lasting undead familiar when it dies.

devotions.name: Wet Dream
devotions.summary: Haunt the target's next sleep, leaving them both Spooked and Swooning.

devotions.name: The Wish
devotions.summary: A consenting mortal gets three nights of borrowed power, then belongs to you.

devotions.name: Vermin Flood
devotions.summary: Call a devouring swarm of small creatures to scour a small area.

devotions.name: Wraith’s Presence
devotions.summary: While cloaked, project a silent decoy image of something elsewhere.

mysteries.name: Mystery of the Ascendant
mysteries.summary: Seeks to overcome sunlight and fire so a Dragon can walk by day.

coil.name: Coil of the Ascendant
coil.summary: Gradually loosens the banes of daysleep, fire and sunlight.

tiers.name: Surmounting the Daysleep
tiers.summary: With blush of life active, no daysleep roll and no Lethargic Condition by day.

tiers.name: The Warm Face
tiers.summary: Blush of life lasts 24 hours instead of one scene.

tiers.name: Conquer the Red Fear
tiers.summary: No longer risks fear frenzy from fire or sunlight.

tiers.name: Peace with the Flame
tiers.summary: With blush of life, fire deals lethal; each Resilience dot downgrades one to bashing.

tiers.name: Sun's Forgotten Kiss
tiers.summary: Extra Vitae on blush of life lowers effective Blood Potency for sunlight intervals.

mysteries.name: Mystery of the Wyrm
mysteries.summary: Treats the Requiem as a gift and trains the Beast to obey.

coil.name: Coil of the Wyrm
coil.summary: Lets the Dragon wake, harness and ride frenzy for power.

tiers.name: Stir the Beast
tiers.summary: Spend 1 Willpower, reflexively frenzy toward a chosen goal; escape rolls at -2 until met.

tiers.name: Beast's Hunger
tiers.summary: In frenzy, add Wyrm Coil dots to Blood Potency for senses and predatory aura.

tiers.name: Leash the Beast
tiers.summary: Riding the wave costs no Willpower; add Wyrm Coil dots to the roll.

tiers.name: Beast's Power
tiers.summary: Abandon resistance in frenzy to add Blood Potency to Defense, Health and Speed.

tiers.name: Eternal Frenzy
tiers.summary: No torpor from full lethal while frenzied; frenzy may persist across scenes.

mysteries.name: Mystery of the Voivode
mysteries.summary: Masters the blood bond to rule others while answering to no one.

coil.name: Coil of the Voivode
coil.summary: Strengthens addiction, bonds and Embrace while shielding the Dragon from control.

tiers.name: Taste of Fealty
tiers.summary: Vitae counts double for addiction; addicts can only sate Deprived on Coil-holder Vitae.

tiers.name: Into the Fold
tiers.summary: Gains blood sympathy with bound subjects; closer bond stage means nearer kinship.

tiers.name: Call to Serve
tiers.summary: Extra Vitae jumps a bond: three for stage two, five for stage three.

tiers.name: Voivode Undisputed
tiers.summary: Blood sympathy gives no Discipline bonus against her; adds it to resist bonds and aura.

tiers.name: The Vast Dynasty
tiers.summary: Embrace becomes a Humanity 3 breaking point with +1 die, not automatic loss.

scales.name: Day-Wake Conditioning
scales.duration: Indefinite while the subject sleeps in bright light nightly; lapses after more than two days without
scales.summary: Reverses a vampire subject's sleep cycle: awake by day, asleep at night.

scales.name: Epidermal Shielding Bath

cost.note: Dragon bleeds Vitae into the bath; each point gives +1 effective Humanity vs sunlight

scales.summary: Hour-long alchemical bath raises a Kindred's effective Humanity against sunlight damage.

scales.name: Flesh Graft Treatment

cost.note: Mortal subjects need Dragon's Vitae in the injection, causing a stage-two blood bond (may make a ghoul)

scales.summary: Blood-soaked grafts let Kindred heal aggravated as lethal; mortals heal lethal with Vitae.

scales.name: Augmented Vitae Draught

cost.note: Vitae spent as for Physical Intensity is drained into a container instead

scales.duration: Stored Vitae lasts hours equal to Blood Potency; boost lasts one scene in a mortal
scales.summary: Bottled Vitae gives a mortal a scene-long physical boost, then bashing damage and addiction.

scales.name: Kindred Sense Endowment
scales.summary: Mortal gains Blood Potency 2 blood senses plus a sickening thirst for blood.

scales.name: Surgical Heart Removal

dicePool.text: Intelligence + Medicine (extended, 10 successes, 1 hour per roll)

scales.duration: Until reversed with an identical roll
scales.summary: Removing a Kindred's heart prevents staking but stops feeding; heart's destruction kills.

scales.name: Blood Cleansing Ritual

cost.note: One repetition (and roll) per Vitae mixed into the wash

dicePool.text: Dragon's Blood Potency - bond creator's Blood Potency

scales.summary: Torturous wash can permanently break a subject's blood bond to another vampire.

scales.name: Fealty's Reward

cost.note: Dragon feeds the subject near death, then returns the blood as Vitae

scales.duration: One year; renewable only by the Dragon
scales.summary: Turns a stage-three bound mortal into a year-long ghoul who becomes a draugr on lapse.

scales.name: Mass Embrace

cost.note: Dragon bleeds out all her Vitae; costs a Humanity dot like a normal Embrace

scales.summary: Embraces a group at once; each subject's chance die decides control, frenzy or draugr.

scales.name: Sanguinary Invigoration
scales.summary: Injected vessel can feed high-Potency Kindred; Dragon smells it from much farther away.

archetypes.name: Authoritarian
archetypes.singleWillpower: Shut down an inferior trying to rise to your level of power.
archetypes.allWillpower: Commit a widespread hit against a rival's mortal connections.

archetypes.name: Child
archetypes.singleWillpower: Find someone to take responsibility for your mistake.
archetypes.allWillpower: Commit a terrible crime to see how authority might react.

archetypes.name: Competitor
archetypes.singleWillpower: Challenge someone clearly your superior.
archetypes.allWillpower: Risk Final Death to prove that you can handle something.

archetypes.name: Conformist
archetypes.singleWillpower: Choose an obviously disadvantageous path, because it fits with protocol.
archetypes.allWillpower: Stand by the losing side with shield at the ready, because it's your side.

archetypes.name: Conspirator
archetypes.singleWillpower: Add a layer of meaningless complexity to a plan.
archetypes.allWillpower: Refuse to take an action in self-defense without excessive, dangerous plotting.

archetypes.name: Courtesan
archetypes.singleWillpower: Put yourself out for another's pleasure.
archetypes.allWillpower: Be the last one dancing when the party's on fire.

archetypes.name: Cult Leader
archetypes.singleWillpower: Convince someone to deny logic because of your word.
archetypes.allWillpower: Risk exile or death to defend your cult's belief system.

archetypes.name: Deviant
archetypes.singleWillpower: Commit a crime against your recognized society.
archetypes.allWillpower: Commit a high crime in plain view of an authority.

archetypes.name: Follower
archetypes.singleWillpower: Follow a directive blindly, for the sake of following.
archetypes.allWillpower: Follow a dangerous directive without hesitation.

archetypes.name: Guru
archetypes.singleWillpower: Give advice that someone uses to succeed.
archetypes.allWillpower: Give protected, dangerous information without asking for payment.

archetypes.name: Idealist
archetypes.singleWillpower: Deny a compromise that would water down your ideal.
archetypes.allWillpower: Refuse safety for fear of abandoning your ideal's purity.

archetypes.name: Jester
archetypes.singleWillpower: Point out an absurdity in the current state of affairs, to lighten the tone.
archetypes.allWillpower: Favor wit and cunning over direct self-defense in a situation of serious danger.

archetypes.name: Junkie
archetypes.singleWillpower: Ignore a problem or responsibility in favor of immediate gratification.
archetypes.allWillpower: Abandon an important relationship over your pursuit of pleasure.

archetypes.name: Martyr
archetypes.singleWillpower: Take another's burden upon yourself without expecting recompense.
archetypes.allWillpower: Put yourself at risk to save someone else or an ideology.

archetypes.name: Masochist
archetypes.singleWillpower: Find and experience a new source of hurt.
archetypes.allWillpower: Willingly explore pain, beyond the point of safety and reason.

archetypes.name: Monster
archetypes.singleWillpower: Cause pain for the sole intention of causing pain.
archetypes.allWillpower: Commit a capital crime without additional motive.

archetypes.name: Nomad
archetypes.singleWillpower: Abandon a home.
archetypes.allWillpower: Abandon a society, organization, or city.

archetypes.name: Nurturer
archetypes.singleWillpower: Put yourself out to help another succeed.
archetypes.allWillpower: Take full responsibility for another's dangerous mistake.

archetypes.name: Perfectionist
archetypes.singleWillpower: Revisit an already successful action to hammer out a flaw.
archetypes.allWillpower: Stick with a failed and dangerous plan, in order to fix what went wrong.

archetypes.name: Penitent
archetypes.singleWillpower: Punish yourself for a mistake.
archetypes.allWillpower: Risk death to correct an egregious error in judgment.

archetypes.name: Questioner
archetypes.singleWillpower: Challenge an accepted truth.
archetypes.allWillpower: Put a long-believed truth to the test, at your own peril.

archetypes.name: Rebel
archetypes.singleWillpower: Openly flout a tradition.
archetypes.allWillpower: Openly flout a Kindred Tradition, or a covenant taboo.

archetypes.name: Scholar
archetypes.singleWillpower: Uncover a lost piece of information.
archetypes.allWillpower: Uncover forbidden knowledge.

archetypes.name: Social Chameleon
archetypes.singleWillpower: Ingratiate yourself to a new social clique.
archetypes.allWillpower: Burn an important bridge to guarantee acceptance in a new group.

archetypes.name: Spy
archetypes.singleWillpower: Build a new identity or uncover a secret.
archetypes.allWillpower: Uncover a damning secret that could end someone.

archetypes.name: Survivor
archetypes.singleWillpower: Favor the safe path over the higher risk, higher reward path.
archetypes.allWillpower: Abandon a social group or relationship in order to stay safe.

archetypes.name: Visionary
archetypes.singleWillpower: Help someone by sharing your vision with them.
archetypes.allWillpower: Put yourself at risk to show a group the power of your vision.

conditions.name: Addicted
conditions.summary: Hooked on something: a drug, gambling, Vitae or another habit that slowly takes over your life. You have to indulge it regularly to keep it in check; going without can bring on Deprived. Choose the addiction when you take this.
conditions.resolution: Regain a dot of Integrity, lose another one, or get an exceptional success on a breaking point.
conditions.beat: You choose a fix over an obligation.

conditions.name: Amnesia
conditions.summary: A whole stretch of your life is missing from your memory, which causes no end of trouble with the people who knew you then.
conditions.resolution: You get the memory back and learn the truth. The Storyteller may make that a breaking point.
conditions.beat: Something you forgot comes back to cause trouble, like an old warrant or enemy.

conditions.name: Bestial
conditions.summary: You act on primal impulse: you run from what scares you and answer aggression with violence. −2 to rolls to resist frenzy or physical impulses and −2 to Defense. Rolls to push you into impulsive aggression or flight are exceptional successes on three successes. It fades after a number of nights equal to the Blood Potency of the vampire who caused it, and can't return for a month after it ends.
conditions.resolution: Deal damage into someone's last three Health boxes.
conditions.possibleSources: A monstrous predatory aura conflict, a breaking point

conditions.name: Broken
conditions.summary: Something in you snapped. You can barely function and flinch from anything more intense than a raised voice. −2 to all Social rolls and to rolls involving Resolve, and −5 to Intimidation.
conditions.resolution: Regain a dot of Integrity, lose another one, or get an exceptional success on a breaking point.
conditions.beat: You back down from a confrontation, or fail a roll because of this Condition.
conditions.possibleSources: Severe psychological trauma, Nightmare, some Ghoul Merits

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.summary: A vampire's Majesty has won you over. She adds her Majesty dots to Manipulation rolls against you, and your rolls to see through her lies or motives lose that many dice; supernatural attempts to read her become a Clash of Wills. You want to please her and will do her favours. It wears off by itself, without being resolved, after an hour per dot of her Blood Potency.
conditions.resolution: She tries to seriously harm you or someone close to you, or you make a significant financial or physical sacrifice for her.
conditions.beat: You reveal a secret to her or do her a favour.

conditions.name: Competitive
conditions.summary: You have to prove you're better. In direct competition, including contested and extended rolls, you take −2 on any roll where you don't spend Willpower. Rolls to goad you into competing are exceptional successes on three successes. It fades after a number of nights equal to the Blood Potency of the vampire who caused it, and can't return for a month after it ends.
conditions.resolution: Win or lose a competition in which someone reaches a breaking point.
conditions.possibleSources: A challenging predatory aura conflict, a breaking point

conditions.name: Confused
conditions.summary: You can't think straight. −2 to Intelligence and Wits rolls.
conditions.resolution: Spend half an hour clearing your head, or take any lethal damage.
conditions.possibleSources: A blow to the head, dramatic failure with some Auspex powers

affects.text: Confused: −2 to Intelligence and Wits rolls

conditions.name: Delusional
conditions.summary: You believe something untrue, like someone poisoning your food or a double replacing a loved one. You don't see things that aren't there, but you can't shake the belief; spending a Willpower lets you explain why it doesn't apply this once, however mad that sounds.
conditions.resolution: Disprove the delusion completely, or destroy the vampire behind it.
conditions.beat: You hold to the belief despite evidence against it.

conditions.name: Dependent
conditions.summary: You're obsessed with a mortal, for their attention and their blood, and suffer the effects of a second-stage blood bond to them.
conditions.resolution: The mortal dies.
conditions.beat: You suffer a loss because you dodged responsibility for the obsession.

conditions.name: Deprived
conditions.summary: You're addicted and can't get a fix, leaving you irritable, anxious and unfocused. −1 to dice pools using Stamina, Resolve or Composure. Traits worked out from them, like Defense, aren't affected.
conditions.resolution: Indulge the addiction.

affects.text: Deprived: −1 to dice pools using Stamina, Resolve or Composure

conditions.name: Distracted
conditions.summary: Confusion and distractions surround you. You can't take extended actions, and take −2 to rolls involving perception, concentration or precision. Resolving this gives no Beat.
conditions.resolution: Leave the swarm.

conditions.name: Dominated
conditions.summary: A vampire has given you a command you can't disobey. A task with a natural end resolves this when it's done; otherwise it ends at sunrise. Afterwards you can't quite remember what you did under her spell.
conditions.resolution: Take more bashing or lethal damage than your Stamina; face a breaking point while obeying and succeed at its Resolve + Composure roll; or carry out the command.

conditions.name: Drained
conditions.summary: You've lost a lot of blood to a vampire. −2 to physical actions and to rolls to stabilise or survive injuries. After any scene of physical exertion, including taking damage, being fed from or spending Willpower on a physical roll, roll Stamina (with wound penalties, but not this one) or pass out for an hour or more.
conditions.resolution: All your lethal damage heals naturally.

conditions.name: Ecstatic
conditions.summary: Blood sorcery has quieted your Beast for now. You feed as though your Blood Potency were three lower (at least 1), and get +2 to avoid frenzy.
conditions.resolution: Feed, sleep, or resist a frenzy.
conditions.possibleSources: Exceptional success on a Crúac ritual

conditions.name: Enervated
conditions.summary: The second stage of soul loss: your Integrity is gone and your Willpower is fading. Besides Soulless's effects, you regain Willpower only through your Vice, and each time you do, your permanent Willpower drops a dot before you refill to the new maximum.
conditions.resolution: Regain your soul.
conditions.beat: Lose a dot of permanent Willpower.

conditions.name: Enslaved
conditions.summary: You're wholly in a vampire's thrall. You can't tell her requests from her Dominate commands; you do what she says and remember what she tells you to. This counts as Mesmerized for Dominate, she only needs you to hear her voice, and your Resolve doesn't penalise her Entombed Command or Possession.
conditions.resolution: Kill the vampire controlling you, or break her control by supernatural means.
conditions.beat: You're made to do something you wouldn't normally do.

conditions.name: Enthralled
conditions.summary: You're fanatically loyal to a vampire and will put your own life at risk for him, for a night per dot of his Blood Potency. Acting against his commands costs a Willpower and is a breaking point at Humanity 1; fail it and you back out at the last moment.
conditions.resolution: Take more lethal damage than your Stamina protecting him, or succeed at a breaking point roll caused by this Condition.
conditions.beat: You put yourself in harm's way to protect him.

conditions.name: False Memories
conditions.summary: You remember things that never happened, and believe them even against strong proof. Being shown that a memory is false is a breaking point at a level the Storyteller sets.
conditions.resolution: Face proof that the memory is false and succeed at the breaking point.
conditions.beat: You trust someone, or take a risk, based only on the false memories.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.summary: Terror has driven out reason: you have to get away from what scared you right now, abandoning belongings and allies, and fight past anyone who stops you. You can't approach or act against the source; if the only way out is past it, you collapse in terror. Vampires and others prone to losing control roll to avoid frenzy. Lasts until the end of the scene; a Willpower holds it off for a turn.
conditions.resolution: Escape from the source of your fear.
conditions.possibleSources: Nightmare, coming face to face with a phobia

conditions.name: Fugue
conditions.summary: Your mind blocks out something terrible, leaving you prone to blackouts and lost time. When things get too much like what caused it, roll Resolve + Composure; on a failure the Storyteller plays your character for the next scene, who tries to avoid the conflict and get away.
conditions.resolution: Regain a dot of Integrity, lose another one, or get an exceptional success on a breaking point.
conditions.beat: You go into a fugue as described.
conditions.possibleSources: Psychological trauma, a breaking point, some Ghoul Merits

conditions.name: Guilty
conditions.summary: You're consumed by guilt and remorse, often after a successful detachment roll. −2 to Resolve or Composure rolls to defend against Subterfuge, Empathy or Intimidation.
conditions.resolution: Confess your crimes and make amends for what you did.
conditions.possibleSources: A breaking point, some Ghoul Merits

conditions.name: Humbled
conditions.summary: You've felt the touch of the divine and feel unworthy and wretched. −2 to Resolve rolls, and you can't regain Willpower from your Requiem.
conditions.resolution: Regain Willpower through your Mask.
conditions.possibleSources: Dramatic failure on a Theban Sorcery ritual

conditions.name: Inspired
conditions.summary: You're deeply inspired. On an action to do with the inspiration you can resolve this: that roll is an exceptional success on three successes, and you regain a Willpower.
conditions.resolution: Use the inspiration on a roll, as described.
conditions.possibleSources: Exceptional success with Crafts or Expression, the Inspiring Merit, Auspex

conditions.name: Intoxicated
conditions.summary: Drunk, drugged or otherwise dulled to the world: not seeing things, but with lowered inhibitions and slower reactions. −2 to Dexterity and Wits dice pools, and anyone using Social maneuvering on you needs two fewer Doors.
conditions.resolution: Sleep it off, or face a breaking point.

affects.text: Intoxicated: −2 to Dexterity and Wits dice pools

conditions.name: Jaded
conditions.summary: You've lost interest in the living and act only for yourself, and the Beast's grip tightens. Your Humanity caps rolls to resist frenzy, and you can't spend Willpower to hold off frenzy, though you can still ride the wave.
conditions.resolution: A meaningful interaction with a Touchstone.

conditions.name: Languid
conditions.summary: Torpor calls to you. You take a cumulative −1 to all actions for each night you've had this, and rising from daysleep costs a Vitae per dot of Blood Potency.
conditions.resolution: Fall into torpor.

conditions.name: Lethargic
conditions.summary: You're fighting daysleep. You can't spend Willpower, and take a cumulative −1 to all actions for every six hours you stay awake. Every six hours, roll Stamina + Resolve (with the penalty) or sleep until the next sunset.
conditions.resolution: Sleep a full day.

conditions.name: Mesmerized
conditions.summary: Your will bows to a vampire's. You seem a little quiet but otherwise normal, and can't resist her commands; doing something out of character makes you look hypnotised or sleepwalking. If you resolve this, you get +3 to resist being Mesmerized again that scene, and remember little of what happened. It fades after a scene, which doesn't count as resolving it.
conditions.resolution: Take any bashing or lethal damage, or face a breaking point as part of a command.

conditions.name: Obsession
conditions.summary: Something is on your mind and you can't let it go. 9-again on rolls to pursue it, and no 10-again on rolls that have nothing to do with it. With the Storyteller's approval it can be temporary.
conditions.resolution: Let go of the fixation.
conditions.beat: You fail an obligation because you were pursuing the obsession.

conditions.name: Raptured
conditions.summary: The fire of Longinus's words puts you in unsettling harmony with your Beast. Riding the wave costs no Willpower and succeeds on three successes instead of five.
conditions.resolution: Fall to frenzy or ride the wave.

conditions.name: Sated
conditions.summary: You gave your Beast an outlet that kept it from frenzy. +1 to rolls to resist frenzy until this is resolved.
conditions.resolution: Frenzy, or resist a significant provocation to frenzy (−3 or worse to resist).

conditions.name: Scarred
conditions.summary: A vampire bit you violently, leaving you disturbed, angry, paranoid and quick to lash out. −2 to rolls to resist fear, such as from Nightmare or Intimidation, and a creature with a predatory aura gets +2 to frighten or intimidate you.
conditions.resolution: Lash out physically, dealing three or more lethal damage to someone.
conditions.possibleSources: A violent bite from a vampire

conditions.name: Shaken
conditions.summary: Something has badly frightened you. When that fear could get in the way of an action, you may choose to fail the roll and resolve this.
conditions.resolution: Give in to the fear and fail a roll, as described.

conditions.name: Soulless
conditions.summary: The first stage of soul loss. You can't attempt abjuration, warding or binding, and rolls to resist possession are at −2. You don't regain Willpower from surrender or rest, and Virtue and Vice swap roles: fulfil your Virtue safely for a Willpower once a scene, or your Vice at risk to yourself once a chapter for all of it. Regaining Willpower through your Vice is a breaking point at −5 unless you're at Integrity 1; for a vampire, at Humanity 2.
conditions.resolution: Regain your soul.
conditions.beat: You lose Integrity because you indulged your Vice.

conditions.name: Spooked
conditions.summary: You've seen something supernatural: not enough to terrify you, but unmistakably otherworldly. How you react is up to you, but it holds your attention.
conditions.resolution: Your fear and fascination make you hinder the group or complicate things, like investigating a noise alone, staying up all night researching, or running instead of standing firm.
conditions.possibleSources: The Unseen Sense Merit, the Wet Dream Devotion

conditions.name: Steadfast
conditions.summary: You're confident and resolved. When you fail a roll, you can resolve this to count it as a single success; on a chance die, resolve it to roll a regular die instead.
conditions.resolution: Your confidence carries you through, as described.

conditions.name: Stumbled
conditions.summary: You've hit a complication in a blood sorcery ritual: each further roll in the extended action is at −3. Resolving this gives no Beat.
conditions.resolution: The ritual ends.
conditions.possibleSources: Dramatic failure on a blood sorcery ritual

conditions.name: Subservient
conditions.summary: A vampire has worn down your will. She can command you as though you were Mesmerized even when you aren't; you can spend a Willpower to resist, but she can then Mesmerize you properly. She still needs Dominate to change your memories. It fades after a week unless she renews it.
conditions.resolution: Take more lethal damage than your Stamina following her command, or face a breaking point while following it and succeed at the roll.
conditions.beat: She makes you do something you wouldn't normally do.

conditions.name: Swooning
conditions.summary: You're attracted to someone and vulnerable to them. −2 to rolls that would harm them; they get +2 on Social rolls against you, and their impression of you counts one level better in Social maneuvering (at most perfect). You can have this more than once, for different people.
conditions.resolution: Put yourself in danger for them, or choose to fail a roll to resist their Social action.
conditions.possibleSources: An exceptional Persuasion or Subterfuge success against you, dramatic failure with Majesty, being fed on gently, help with your Vice (mortals)

conditions.name: Tainted
conditions.summary: You committed diablerie and traces of your victim's soul remain. Once a chapter they can haunt you, taking their Blood Potency in dice from one of your dice pools or adding it to a pool against you. You can have this more than once, one for each victim.
conditions.resolution: Months equal to the victim's Blood Potency pass; each aggravated damage you take shortens that by a month.

conditions.name: Tasked
conditions.summary: Your clan, covenant or family has given you a duty that carries weight. 8-again on rolls toward the task, and no 10-again on rolls that aren't.
conditions.resolution: Complete the task, or fail it.

conditions.name: Tempted
conditions.summary: You refused the Beast, but it stays near the surface. −1 to rolls to resist frenzy, worse by one each time you resist again, e.g. "Tempted −3" after three resistances.
conditions.resolution: Kill, fall to frenzy, or have a meaningful connection with a Touchstone.

conditions.name: Thrall
conditions.summary: You've fully succumbed to soullessness. You can't spend Willpower or Experiences, can't use Defense, and suffer all the effects of Broken. Only keep playing the character if there's a chance of regaining the soul.
conditions.resolution: Regain your soul.
conditions.beat: You're victimised because of this Condition.

affects.text: Thrall (as Broken): −2 to rolls involving Resolve

conditions.name: Wanton
conditions.summary: You want, for the sake of wanting. −2 to Composure or Resolve rolls to resist temptation, and whoever caused this gets exceptional successes on three successes when tempting you, including with Majesty. It fades after a number of nights equal to the Blood Potency of the vampire who won the aura conflict (or your own, after a detachment roll), and can't return for a month after it ends.
conditions.resolution: Indulge in something that's a breaking point.
conditions.possibleSources: A seductive predatory aura conflict, a breaking point
